what: Clicking a work or article link does not navigate — a sheet rises from below (.6s expo.out) and covers everything except a small gap at the top of the screen, with a scrim laid behind it. Opening another sheet inside it moves the one below down 2rem, shrinks it to .94 and darkens it (.8s power2.out). It closes via the close button, the scrim or Esc, and dragging the handle down closes it when the speed is 500 or more or it passes halfway, over remaining distance/speed (.15~.45s).
ease: expo.out (rise · drop) · power2.out (stacked panels · drag to close)
needs: Observer (drag to close — without it, only dragging is missing)

options.dur·under: Duration (s) of the rise and the overlapping panels, default .6 and .8 — shorten for apps that open and close often
options.--fx-top·--fx-max-width·--fx-scrim: Panel lift · max panel width · veil color (CSS variables)
options.[data-fx-part=open][data-key]: Open button/link (child) — opens the panel with the same data-key
options.[data-fx-part=sheet][data-key]: Panel (child) — nesting another open inside makes them open stacked
options.fx:open·fx:close: Send to the element to open and close it (fx:open is detail.key)

use:
View work
…

from.where: shared.js .s-drawer (work·collection links → drawer, stacked opening · drag to close)

index.html #project Work detail (original magnific-popup 1.1.0 mfp-zoom-in — panel translate 0 100% → 0 .5s ease-in-out, backdrop #194354 fixed at .4, closing cut at removalDelay 400ms, inside the window a separate Lenis on PC)
from.options: dur: .5; ease: 0.42,0,0.58,1 · --fx-top: 0 · --fx-scrim is a deep teal
from.note: The original has no drag-to-close and the sheet covers the whole screen (top offset 0)

note: Since dragging the sheet closed is this part’s job, touch is intercepted only when a finger swipes down from the very top of the sheet (not once the inside has scrolled). The original’s bottom-sheet dark overlay .15 is rendered as brightness .85. The original also changes the URL (back closes it), but this part doesn’t touch the URL — if needed, the consumer connects history to fx:open·fx:close
